elements.element: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause does not require commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability coverage or per-occurrence limit is stated.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability coverage or aggregate limit is stated.

elements.element: HDI must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause expressly requires HDI to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If HDI processes Customer Data, HDI must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance unconditionally, so the coverage obligation applies regardless of whether the Customer Data processing condition is triggered.

elements.element: If HDI processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative provisions do not demonstrate that HDI does not process Customer Data: HDI hosts the Site and may access user information and data. The rendered clause provides only a USD 2,000,000 cyber and privacy limit, not USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: HDI must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: HDI must provide certificates of insurance upon request.

result.reason: The operative addition fully reaches the fallback position but omits several preferred coverages and limits. It is not strictly minimal because the rendered text also reorders the pre-existing sections, an unnecessary change unrelated to insurance. The unrelated substantive language remains unchanged and effective. The insurance sentence itself is clear, but overall drafting quality is low because the new provision is unnumbered and the document sections were unnecessarily rearranged.
